Welcome to LSE’s External jobs site

You have reached this page because you have identified yourself as not currently working or studying for LSE. If you are an existing LSE staff member, student or a current agency worker engaged at the school please return to our welcome page and click on "Internal Vacancies" to ensure you see both internal and external vacancies.
Please note all posts close at 23:59 UK time on the date given in the advert. If you are unsure what time this is in your current location, please use a website like www.timeanddate.com to look up the time in your time zone.
You can search our current vacancies right now. There is no need to create an account until you are ready to apply for a vacancy. You can use the filters, or to view all our current vacancies, click on the search button.
All communication regarding your application will be via email, so please ensure that the email address you give when applying is accurate and you will be able to access it on a regular basis.
Register for a Vacancy Alert
To make searching for your ideal position easy, click on the "Vacancy Alert" button and register your interest, in a specific role/area. Whenever a vacancy arises we will contact you by email providing you with the details of the position so you can make an online application. Please click the button to register for a "Vacancy Alert".

LSE is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive university

The School is pleased to announce that it will be introducing the anonymisation of job applications for all professional services staff at the end of October 2019.
From 31 October 2019, the LSE online E-recruitment system will automatically anonymise job application forms for all professional services staff.
The areas that will be anonymised will be: Title, forename, surname, address, email address and contact phone numbers.
Applicants will only be identified by their candidate number. Applicants will no longer be able to upload their CV. Instead we have developed an online application form with the ability for applicants to provide a supporting statement where they can demonstrate how they meet the requisite criteria for the role.
Applicant details will only be revealed once an interview slot has been confirmed.
These changes do not apply to academic, research or teaching positions. Please visit the ‘How to Apply’ document for professional services staff.
